body.what_is:

body.what_is:
Les Menuires, its heart at La Croisette (1,850 m) in the Belleville valley, lines up a local domain of 81 runs and 30 lifts shared with Saint-Martin-de-Belleville — 16% green, 41% blue — with 85% of the domain above 1,800 m, and the 3 Vallées link over the Mont de la Chambre (2,800 m). The resort sits 'at the centre of the world's largest ski area': '600 kilometres of runs and 156 lifts' — courchevel.com counts 155; both figures are quoted.

The rarity lies elsewhere: the official 2026 beginner piste map names the free lifts one by one — seven carpets (Pelvoux, covered Les Plans, Reberty 1850, Preyerand, covered Les Bruyères, Biolley 1 and 2), the Village drag lift, the Croisette gondola and the Preyerand cable car: ten machines without a pass. Add the free shuttles within the resort and to Val Thorens and Saint-Martin, 36 fun zones and 10 sledging areas, the 4 km Roc'n Bob sledge run and the La Mine rail sledge.

faq.a: The official 2026 beginner piste map lists them: the Pelvoux, Les Plans (covered), Reberty 1850, Preyerand, Les Bruyères (covered) and Biolley 1 and 2 carpets, the Village drag lift, the Croisette gondola and the Preyerand cable car — ten machines, no pass needed.
5 December 2026 to 18 April 2027, per the 3 Vallées 'Winter 26/27' calendar — consistent with the 2026-27 pricing periods already online at lesmenuires.com.

Two registers: Roc'n Bob, 4 km of snow sledging from La Croisette, and La Mine, a rail sledge in the Bruyères quarter (from age 5 and 1.10 m). The resort counts 10 sledging areas and 36 fun zones in all.
Free shuttles within the resort, and valley shuttles to Val Thorens and Saint-Martin-de-Belleville; public lifts and laid-out walking paths complete the network.

research_log: Research 2026-08-18, FR pages only (lesmenuires.com + plan officiel des pistes débutant 2026, les3vallees.com). Domaine local Les Menuires–Saint-Martin : 81 pistes, 30 remontées (16 % vertes, 41 % bleues, 33 % rouges, 10 % noires). 3 Vallées « 600 km et 156 remontées » (vs 155 chez courchevel.com — reportée). Saison 26/27 : 5 décembre – 18 avril (les3vallees.com, cohérent avec les périodes tarifaires du site). GRATUIT, listé nominativement sur le plan débutant 2026 : 7 tapis (Pelvoux, Plans couvert, Reberty 1850, Preyerand, Bruyères couvert, Biolley 1 & 2), téléski du Village, télébenne de la Croisette, téléphérique de Preyerand — 10 appareils. Navettes gratuites intra-station et vers Val Thorens / Saint-Martin. 36 espaces ludiques, 10 espaces luges ; Roc'n Bob 4 km ; luge sur rails La Mine. Été : 90 activités, remontées 04/07–28/08.
